title: E-learning: Manage SAP Variant Configuration and Pricing and SAP Intelligent Product Recommendation
author: IcyHuang
text:
In today’s competitive market, companies that sell complex products need to provide accurate quotes quickly and meet customers’ unique needs. However, managing many product options, pricing rules, and configurations manually can be slow and prone to errors. Sales teams may find it difficult to choose the right product setup for each customer, which can lead to delayed quotes, lost sales opportunities, and a poorer customer experience. 
 To improve product selection and drive revenue growth, companies need a solution that combines product configuration, pricing, and AI-powered recommendations. This 1.5 hour e-learning course is designed for business users involved in sales, product configuration, or customer engagement who want to learn how SAP supports personalized customer experiences and optimized product selection. 
 Introducing the New E-learning Course 
 This course begins with the foundational concepts of SAP Variant Configuration and Pricing, explores the AI-powered capabilities of SAP Intelligent Product Recommendation, and concludes with a practical look at how these solutions integrate seamlessly. It is structured to give business users a clear, end-to-end picture — from understanding how products are configured and priced to seeing how machine learning can personalise and accelerate the customer experience. 
 This E-learning course contains three units with an assessment at the end of each unit to test your knowledge. 
 Identifying the Foundations of SAP Variant Configuration and Pricing for Optimized Customer Satisfaction 
 Leveraging SAP Intelligent Product Recommendations Capabilities to Enhance Product Personalization 
 Improving Efficiency Through Seamless Integration 
 Ready to Get Started? 
 Take the next step in your learning journey by enrolling in the Managing SAP Variant Configuration and Pricing and SAP Intelligent Product Recommendation e-learning course. 
 📝 Note: Access to this E-learning requires a one-time registration to SAP Learning. 

 Enhance Your SAP Experience with Value Maps 
 Beyond this e-learning, SAP Enterprise Support offers additional resources to help you drive innovation. Value maps on SAP Community bring together guidance, recommended actions, and supporting resources to help you decide what to focus on next - all included in your SAP cloud subscription. 
 Looking for more e-learning resources on SAP Financial Management capabilities? Visit this article in Finance Management value map to discover additional learning content and resources. To access the Value Map Groups , login to the SAP Community using an S-user ID or a Universal ID. 
 👉 Watch our short demo video , then head over to our page to explore our range of topics and request a call with a value map topic expert for guidance tailored to your goals. 
 About the author: 
 Icy Huang is a Topic Expert for SAP Enterprise Support value maps, specializing in SAP S/4HANA Cloud. Based in Singapore, Icy has been with SAP since 2007, taking on diverse roles that have largely centered around customer engagement and success across the organization. Now she focuses on helping business accelerate the adoption of SAP S/4HANA Cloud solutions with value map content and SAP Enterprise Support offerings.

title: 资产会计 - 如何创建折旧码/激活折旧档案功能 - SAP ERP 公有云
author: evelynliu
text:
自 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2608 版本起， 折旧码的专家配置现已有替代方案： 
 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2608 中， SAP 提供可配置的折旧档案， 用以替代之前预定义的折旧码。试点客户已可在此版本中使用可配置的折旧档案； 其他所有客户可在 UI 上查看折旧档案。在后续版本中， 所有客户的折旧码将完全被可配置的折旧档案所替代。 

 如您对新的折旧档案功能感兴趣，请参阅 SAP 帮助门户上的详细信息： 
 新增功能信息： 引入可配置折旧参数文件 
 资产会计产品协助： 从折旧码过渡到折旧参数文件 
 如您决定成为试点客户，请创建单独的支持案例， 
 要求 SAP 激活折旧档案功能。提交支持案例时，应使用以下参数： 
 支持组件： FI-AA-AA-A-2CL 
 优先级：中 
 主题：折旧档案请求 
 报告问题时的系统选择，请参阅 KBA 3795748 - CE2608 - 可配置折旧档案简介 -SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Edition 

 参考系统： 
 默认情况下，指定生产系统（系统类型PROD）。 
 如果您只有一个 starter system ，指定您的 starter system 。 
 如果您只有一个 partner demo system ，指定您的 partner demo system 。 
 如果您只有测试系统而尚无生产系统，指定您的测试系统。 

 SAP 随后将检查您的系统是否可以切换到折旧档案。 
 （可能的拒绝原因是您所在国家 / 地区尚未在技术上支持折旧档案。） 

 如您计划为 SAP 未提供国家 / 地区特定内容的国家 / 地区（即所谓的 CLT 国家） 
 请求折旧码，请注意以下事项： SAP 将不会批准此专家配置请求。 
 相反， SAP 建议您请求折旧档案。 
 如果您的系统是新安装， SAP 同样建议您请求折旧档案， 并从一开始就利用可配置的折旧档案的优势。 
 但是，如果您仍然想使用折旧码的专家配置服务， 请使用折旧码模板，执行所需操作，并指定传输编号。 
 请注意，资产会计中预先批准的折旧码专家配置不支持平行线。 
 如您需要其他折旧码，请在主线中请求和实施预先批准的专家配置。 
 （另请参阅： SAP Note 3754571 - Release Note for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, Parallel Line with 2608 Release - SAP … .) 

 非常感谢！

title: Step-by-Step Guide: Configuring SAP BDC Connect for Google BigQuery
author: Parishudh-Marupurolu
text:
From Setup to First Query: Set up zero-copy access from SAP Business Data Cloud to Google BigQuery in seven steps, with step-by-step screenshots. Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 Unifying Enterprise Context: The Power of SAP and Google Cloud Synergy 
 SAP systems run the core of the enterprise, including finance, supply chain, HR, and customer experience, through end-to-end processes like Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Plan-to-Produce, Record-to-Report, and Hire-to-Retire. To make fast, data-driven decisions and put AI to work, organizations want to combine native SAP business semantics with Google Cloud data and AI capabilities. 
 Historically, connecting these platforms required data replication pipelines, which added complexity, latency, and challenges in maintaining native SAP business context and hierarchies. 
 To simplify this, Google Cloud and SAP co-engineered SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) Connect for Google BigQuery — now generally available. 
 Using a zero-copy architecture powered by open-source Delta Sharing with built-in access controls, this integration lets you query live SAP BDC data products directly from BigQuery — and vice versa — without building replication pipelines. This helps bring the scale of BigQuery to your SAP data while keeping governance in place and data fresh. 
 Official Resources & Key Documentation 
 Before diving into the configuration steps, bookmark these official resources to reference during your rollout: 
 Google Cloud Blog: SAP and Google Cloud launch BDC Connect for BigQuery 
 Google Documentation: About SAP Business Data Cloud integration | Lakehouse Docs 
 SAP Community: Announcing GA of SAP BDC Connect for Google BigQuery 
 Google Cloud docs: Set up cross-cloud connection for SAP BDC 
 SAP Help: Obtaining Access to Data Products through SAP Business Data Cloud Connect 
 Keep these open in a tab. The rest of this post walks through each configuration step. 
 Roles & Responsibilities: Team Alignment Matrix 
 You’ll need three people (or one person wearing three hats): 
 BigQuery Administrator: Handles BigQuery Enterprise Plus capacity setup, sets up the Lakehouse catalog, and executes queries on shared tables through the Google Cloud Console. 
 SAP Administrator: Deploys the BDC Connect instance, links the Google Cloud Service Account, and generates the activation link (connector endpoint and invitation code) in SAP for Me. 
 SAP BDC User: Finds data products in the SAP BDC catalog, requests access, and installs them to the BDC Connect instance for BigQuery (Step 7). 
 Prerequisites & System Readiness 
 Before you begin the step-by-step walkthrough, verify that you have completed these preparation steps on both platforms. 
 Tenant deployment: Ensure your SAP BDC environment is active on a supported cloud platform (such as Google Cloud or AWS). 
 Ensure your SAP administrator has access to your SAP BDC environment to configure the BDC Connect application 
 You must have appropriate IAM permissions in Google Cloud to create and manage Lakehouse Catalogs: BigLake Admin (roles/biglake.admin) or BigQuery Admin (roles/bigquery.admin). 
 The target Google Cloud project must use BigQuery Enterprise Plus Edition. 
 Step-by-Step Screenshot-Guided Walkthrough 
 Phase 1: Google Cloud Environment Preparation (Steps 1–3) — Configure BigQuery Enterprise Plus capacity, assign your project to the reservation, and initiate the Lakehouse Delta Sharing catalog. 
 Phase 2: SAP BDC Provisioning & Mutual Handshake (Steps 4–6) — Provision the connector in SAP for Me, exchange credentials to enroll the catalog, and link the connection into the SAP landscape formation. 
 Phase 3: Data Federation & Live BigQuery Analytics (Step 7) — Share SAP data products from the SAP BDC Catalog & Marketplace and execute zero-copy SQL queries directly within BigQuery Studio. 
 Step 1: [BigQuery Admin | Google Cloud] Enable BigQuery Enterprise Plus Capacity 
 1. Access the BigQuery interface via the Google Cloud Console . 
 2. Navigate through the sidebar to Administration > Workload management > Capacity management. 
 3. Click Create Reservation. Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 Administration → Workload management → Capacity Management. Click Create Reservation to start. 
 4. Reservation Name: Assign a unique identifier, such as gcp-sap-bdc-connect-bq (the name used in this walkthrough). 
 5. Location: Choose the specific region hosting your datasets; this must align with your Lakehouse catalog setting. 
 6. Edition: Pick Enterprise Plus from the available options. 
 Why Enterprise Plus? BDC Connect queries require BigQuery Enterprise Plus edition. With baseline slots set to 0 and autoscaling on (below), you pay for autoscaled slots while queries run instead of paying for idle baseline capacity. 
 7. Slots: 
 Configure Baseline slots to 0: This avoids paying for idle baseline capacity. 
 Turn on Auto Scaling so BigQuery adds slots only while queries are running, up to the maximum you set. For this demo we used Extra Small (50 slots) as the maximum, which is enough for a few test queries. For production, size the maximum to your own workloads as part of your sizing exercise. The BigQuery slot estimator can help. 
 8. Finalize the configuration by clicking Save. Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 Your new reservation now appears under Capacity management: Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 The new Enterprise Plus reservation, ready for an assignment. 
 Step 2: [BigQuery Admin | Google Cloud] Assign Your Project to the Reservation 
 Navigate to the Capacity management page. Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 From the reservation’s Actions menu, choose Create assignment. 
 2. Select your newly created reservation ID, then click the More actions menu (three dots) under the Actions column. 
 3. Click + Create Assignment. 
 4. For Rule type, select Job Routing (Assignment). 
 5. Select a resource: Choose the Project, Folder, or Organization that will be running the BigQuery jobs. 
 6. Job type: Select Query (this routes query jobs to the Enterprise Plus reservation). You can also add assignments for Pipeline or Background jobs if required. Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 A Job Routing rule for your project with job type QUERY. The Rule Summary shows where the jobs go. 
 7. Click Continue. 
 8. Reservation: Select the Enterprise Plus reservation created in the previous step (e.g., “gcp-sap-bdc-connect-bq”). 
 9. Click Continue. Your project will appear under your reservation (in this walkthrough, the reservation name and project ID share the name gcp-sap-bdc-connect-bq). Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 Your project now sits under the reservation, so its queries use Enterprise Plus capacity. 
 Verification: Once assigned, query jobs run within that project use Enterprise Plus capacity. You can verify this by checking the Job Information in the BigQuery Job History; it should list the reservation name and edition. 
 Step 3: [BigQuery Admin | Google Cloud] Create the Lakehouse Delta Sharing Catalog 
 A Delta Sharing catalog in Lakehouse serves as your gateway to federating with the remote SAP BDC catalog. 
 1. Enable the BigLake API. 
 2. Review the roles required to enable APIs, then select Enable the API. 
 3. In the Google Cloud console, open the Lakehouse page: Go to Lakehouse 
 4. In the navigation menu, click Runtime catalog . 
 5. Click Create catalog and select Federated catalog . Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 Lakehouse → Runtime catalog → Create catalog → Federated catalog. 
 6. In the Catalog configuration section, enter the following: 
 a. For Federated catalog source, select SAP (Business Data Cloud). 
 b. For Catalog name (in Lakehouse) , enter a name for your catalog. 
 c. For Data location , select the same Lakehouse region as reservation. Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 Choose SAP (Business Data Cloud) as the source, name the catalog, and pick its region. 
 Click Continue. The next screen, Connection details, asks for a Connector endpoint and an Invitation code. You don’t have these yet. Your SAP admin generates them in Step 4, and you’ll come back here to enter them in Step 5. For now, continue past this screen. Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 Copy this service account. Your SAP administrator needs it in Step 4. 
 7. Click Continue . 
 8. Retrieve the Google Cloud Service Account ID displayed on the page and provide this ID to your SAP administrator. 
 Why this matters: This service account is how SAP BDC recognizes and trusts BigQuery. When your SAP administrator registers this ID during BDC Connect provisioning, SAP BDC authorizes BigQuery to query Delta Sharing endpoints directly without needing static credentials, passwords, or shared secret keys. 
 Step 4: [SAP Admin | SAP for Me] Configure the BDC Connect Instance 
 Your SAP administrator must sign in to SAP for Me and provision a new instance of the BDC Connect application: 
 Go to Portfolio & Products and select Business Data Cloud. Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 In SAP for Me, open Portfolio & Products and select your Business Data Cloud package. 
 2. Under Business Data Cloud, click Application. 
 3. Locate SAP Business Data Cloud Connect and click Start Provisioning. 

 On the Applications tab, find SAP BDC Connect and click Start Provisioning. 
 4. Enter the Display Name . 
 5. Select or create a Resource Group . Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 Give the solution a name and choose where it lives, then click Next Step. 
 6. Allocate BDC Capacity Units (CUs) . How many you need depends entirely on your SAP BDC sizing exercise. Estimate your expected workloads with SAP’s Capacity Unit Cost Estimator, then assign quota to match. We used 10 CUs for this demo, which may not be a production recommendation. Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 Assign Capacity Units to SAP BDC Connect. We used 10 for this demo. 
 7. In the External System Instance Identifier field, provide the Google Cloud service account ID you copied in Step 3. 
 8. Choose a Region . Ensure this matches the region where your SAP BDC tenant is located (the BDC Core region). Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 Paste the Google Cloud service account and choose the region of your SAP BDC tenant. 
 9. Click Review, verify the details, and then click Finish . 

 10. Upon selecting Finish, a notification prompt entitled Creating solution will appear: 
 Your provisioning request for the 'GCP BDC Demo' solution has started and its resources are being set up in the selected resource group. The provisioning process can take a few moments to complete. 
 The new Solution resource will achieve the Ready status when all tenants are successfully provisioned, and integrations are fully established. 
 11. Navigate to the Resources view to monitor deployment progress for provisioned components. Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 While provisioning runs, the status shows Processing. View Notifications shows the progress. 
 After completion, go to the tenant details view. Hold the pointer over the View Tenant Notifications button to get the Activation Link , which contains the SAP Connector Endpoint and the SAP Invitation Code . Press enter or click to view image in full size 

 The tenant notification holds the activation URL, with both the endpoint and the invitation code. 
 Provide the following activation parameters to your BigQuery administrator to complete the connection handshake: 
 Deconstructing the Handshake URL 
 When enrolling the catalog in the Google Cloud Console, split the activation URL into its two core parameters: 
 Connector Endpoint: The base URL preceding ?code= (e.g., https://d1xxxx-xxx-xxxxx-xxx-xxxxxx.sharing.xx.xxxx-xxxx.hanaxxxx.ondemand.com). 
 Invitation Code: The alphanum

title: SAP BTP Hackathon 2026 ファイナリスト座談会 Vol.1
author: KeisukeNakamura
text:
SAP SAP BTP Hackathon 2026 ファイナリスト座談会 Vol.1 
 本記事では末尾に用語注釈を掲載しています。文中に不明な用語がありましたら、あわせてご参照ください。 
 はじめに 
 「 SAP BTP Hackathon 2026 」は、 SAP ジャパン株式会社の主催するパートナー / お客様向けのハッカソンイベントです。 5 年目の開催となった今年のハッカソンは、 54 社 70 チーム 422 名が参加されました。 

 　本ブログは「 SAP BTP Hackathon 2026 」において、一次選考を通過し、ファイナリストとなった TISI 株式会社様 ( 以下、 TISI ）、アクセンチュア株式会社様（以下、アクセンチュア）、アビームシステムズ株式会社様（以下、アビームシステムズ）の 3 社によって行われた座談会についての記事です。 
 イベントの流れとしては、 2026 年 5 月よりイネーブルメントセッションを実施し、同年 6 月より 1 週間のハッカソンを行いました。その後 SAP ジャパンによる選考を経て、 7/3( 金 ) に一次選考を突破したファイナリストチーム 6 組が集まり、たくさんの参加者や SAP 社員が見守る中で、渾身のプレゼンテーションを行い、最優秀作品とチームを決める最終選考イベントを実施いたしました。 
 今年のハッカソンのテーマは、「業務プロセスを再設計せよ。〜 最強の “ 相棒 ” と創る、省力化と高度化のネクストステージ 〜」」でした。このテーマにおいて、ファイナリストに選定された６社様を 2 組に分け、座談会という形で現在の率直な思いを赤裸々にお話しいただきました。 

 【編集注】本ブログ公開時点で、 SAP Business Technology Platform （ SAP BTP ）（ ※1 ）は SAP Business AI Platform に名称変更されています。 本文中の SAP BTP や SAP Business Technology Platform はすべて 現在の SAP Business AI Platform に相当します。 「 SAP BAIP 」および「 BAIP 」は SAP 公式な呼称としては認められていないため、 本ブログでは旧略称「 SAP BTP 」をそのまま使用しています。 

 チーム / 座談会参加者紹介 
 1.TISI 株式会社様 

 写真左から順に、 
 馬場冬太氏：産業公共事業本部 ERP コンサルティング第 1 事業部 エンタープライズコンサルティング第 2 部 チーフ。 ERP ビジネス領域にて Oracle EBS の購買・販売領域を中心に約 10 年従事し、 PL や開発チームリード を担当。そ の後 SAP の周辺システムおよびインターフェース領域を中心に約 7 年携わり、近年は SAP S/4HANA ・ BTP 関連案件の推進に従事。本ハッカソンではデータ基盤の整備やシステム連携周りなど、開発側 の実装領域を中心に担当。 

 森麻沙樹氏：産業公共事業本部 ERP ビジネス推進部 エキスパート。 ERP ビジネス領域にて SAP BASIS および 生成 AI 活用を担当し、約 15 年にわたり SAP 関連業務（ HEC や RISE のプリセールス含む）に従事。現在は 生成 AI の企画・技術推進や人材育成を担い、 SAP BTP や Joule を活用した AI エージェント開発にも注力。本ハッカソンでは AI 領域全般の統括、および SAP BTP 各種ソリューションを組み合わせたアーキテクチャ設計を担当し、企画アイデアを技術・サービスとして具現化する領域をリード。 

 有木秀悟氏：産業公共事業本部 ERP コンサルティング第 1 事業部 エンタープライズコンサルティング第 2 部 エキスパート。 SAP 導入プロジェクトに約 10 年従事し、生産・販売物流領域を中心に複数の案件でプロジェク トマネジメントや開発チームリードを担当。近年は SAP S/4HANA ・ BTP 関連案件の推進に携わる。本ハッカソ ンではチームの窓口・事務局として、チーム活動全体の運営や進行管理を担当。 

 藤本堅太朗氏：産業公共事業本部 ERP コンサルティング第 1 事業部 エンタープライズコンサルティング第 2 部 エキスパート。 ERP ビジネス領域にて SAP 導入案件の提案・企画構想から導入までを担当し、 20 年以上にわ たり製造業、商社、鉄道、監査法人など幅広い業界の新規導入案件を経験。主に財務会計 / 管理会計をリード し、業務・会計とシステムの双方の視点から支援を実施。本ハッカソンではビジネスアイデアの創出およびシ ナリオ設計を担当し、ソリューション全体のストーリー構築と価値訴求を牽引。 
 このほか、板東 高志氏（ CAP ・ OData V4 によるサービス実装）、田畑 博光氏（アイデアの補完と、 AI 駆動開発 の推進）、中嶋 愛佳氏（ UI5 アプリの UI 設計）、森山 全氏（過去のハッカ ソン参加経験をもとに知見を共有）を加えた計 8 名がチームを構成しています。 
 2. アビームシステムズ株式会社様 

 写真左から順に 、 
 樅山将人氏（スペシャリスト） : ソリューションビジネスユニット　経営基盤グループ所属。 SAP 周辺システムの BI 領域を中心に、ロジスティクス関連データを扱うシステムの要件定義、開発、運用保守に従事。 

 伊與田幸介氏（アシスタント） : ソリューションビジネスユニット　会計ソリューショングループ所属。 SAP BW 領域の運用保守やアップグレードプロジェクト、および SAP 会計領域の開発・運用保守を担当。 

 和田晶氏（アシスタント） : ソリューションビジネスユニット　経営基盤グループ所属。 SAP 会計領域を中心に運用保守、子会社ロールアウトなどに約 2 年間従事。 

 森下望美氏（アソシエイトマネージャー） : ソリューションビジネスユニット　サプライチェーンソリューショングループ所属。 SAP 導入・運用保守・アップグレードプロジェクトに約 10 年従事。 SCM 領域を中心に、複数の SAP 案件でプロジェクトマネジメントやチームリードを担当。 

 駒瀬真子氏（スタッフ） : ソリューションビジネスユニット　サプライチェーンソリューショングループ所属。 SAP ロジスティクス領域を中心に、運用保守・ ABAP 開発に約 4 年従事 。

 1. TISI株式会社様 
 ソリューション概要/アーキテクチャ図 

 藤本氏（ TISI ） ： 経営層に現場の情報が高い解像度で上がってこない、というのは多くの企業が抱える課題だと思います。その原因は人間の組織である以上の宿命のようなもので、リアルタイムの情報収集も、一人の人間が多角的に判断することも物理的にできません。 
 でも、 AI エージェント（ ※1 ）を入れたらできてしまうのでは、というのが出発点です。 特徴は、 3 つの AI ペルソナが同時に解釈を行う点です。言い方を変えると、私たちは「 AI が最適解を提案する」ということに非常に懐疑的なのです。その解決策として、異なる 3 つの意見を出し、最終的に判断するのは人間。スコアリングもしないし、優劣もつけない。このコンセプトを守った形でソリューションを設計しました。 
 外部情報の収集も含め、 SAP が提供している各種機能をできる限りすべて活用して動かす、というコンセプトで組み上げています。アーキテクチャ図の右上にある AI 層には 7 個の AI エージェントを配置していて、 3 つのペルソナはそれぞれ並列で動きつつ、全体をオーケストレーションするメインのエージェントと有機的につながっています。 
 森氏（ TISI ） ： こだわった点としては、 SAP が掲げる Autonomous Enterprise （ ※2 ）の文脈を体現するショーケースとなるソリューションを目指したことです。また、今回のようなシナリオに限らず、汎用的に使える仕組みにすることも意識しました。 
 設計の前提として「 AI は信用ならないもの」と定義し、 AI はあくまでワーカーとして動かす。その上にオーケストレーター（ ※3 ）がいて、最下層には普遍的なデータ層がある。 
 そのデータできちんと情報を収集・分析し、判断材料として人が承認する。 Human-in-the-loop （ ※4 ）の仕組みを設け、小さくても動くものをフルスコープで実装しきった点が、私たちの強みだと考えています。 
 2. アビームシステムズ 
 ソリューション概要/アーキテクチャ図 

 森下氏（アビームシステムズ） ： 私たちは現場の在庫管理に着目し、食品業界の期限管理、具体的には期限が迫った在庫の扱いと廃棄ロス削減を担うエージェントを作りました。これまで人が行っていた在庫の確認から、その在庫をどうするかの判断・実行までを、 Joule （ ※5 ）が自律的に進めます。効果としては、コスト削減、廃棄するはずだった在庫を売上に変えること、そして廃棄ロス削減による ESG 対応を挙げています。 
 一番のポイントは、業務プロセス全体を再設計したことです。これまで人が複数のシステムを使って行っていた業務を、 Joule が一気通貫で実行できるようにしました。加えて、クリーンコア（ ※6 ）や Fit to Standard （ ※7 ）、誰でも操作できる UI など、これからの ERP に求められる要素を短期間で具現化できたと思っています。 
 現状の課題は 2 つあります。倉庫担当者は大量のロットを確認しなければならず、期限管理に手間がかかる。そして、期限間近の在庫が見つかっても、 SCM 担当者が過去事例を調べたり、販路変更のために営業と調整したり、上長の承認を得て ERP に登録したりと多くのステップがあり、リードタイムが長くなる。その結果、廃棄ロスにつながってしまいます。 
 To-Beでは、まず Joule が期限間近の在庫ロットを検出して一覧表示します。対応したいロットを選ぶと、過去実績などから値引き、販路変更、転送、フードバンクへの寄付といった最適な行き先を提案。そこで人が確認・承認すると、 Joule がワークフローを回し、 ERP への登録まで自律的に行います。 
 従来、こうした課題にはアドオンを作って対応する発想が主流だったと思いますが、 Joule を使うことでアドオンを作らず、スタンダードを維持したままエンドツーエンドのプロセスを実行できるエージェントにできました。アーキテクチャもとてもシンプルで、ほぼコーディングせずに標準機能で実現しています。基本的には Joule Studio （ ※8 ）、 SAP Build Work Zone （ ※9 ）、 SAP Build Process Automation （ ※10 ）を使い、 SAP S/4HANA （ ※11 ）と接続して構築しました。 
 チームは若手中心で、普段は別々の仕事をしているメンバーが集まっています。それぞれが持っている現場の課題感を話し合いながらプロセスをつなげ、このエージェントに仕上げました。 
 3. アクセンチュア株式会社様 
 ソリューション概要/アーキテクチャ図 

 谷村氏（アクセンチュア） ： 出発点は、端的に言うと「売れるものを作りたかった」ことです。地政学リスクは SAP に関わる企業なら誰もが直面する「あるある」なので、まずこれを取り上げました。 もうひとつ、今年はどの会社も似たアイデアを出してくるだろうと考えていました。巷では、 ERP を裏側に置き、表でエージェントがどんどん動いて、人が何も触らなくても業務が進む「ゼロタッチオペレーション」（ ※12 ）が技術的には実現できる状況です。 
 ただ実際にそれをやると、内部統制や、判断が適切かどうかといった問題が出てくる。だからこそ、適切なタイミングで人の判断を挟むことが大事になる。この 2 つを掛け合わせて作りました。ゼロタッチで動いた結果がいったん人に集約され、人の決定をもとにまた裏でエージェントが動く。要所要所で意思決定が挟まるのが、これからのビジネスプロセスの形になると考えています。 各社のアイデアが似通ってくる中、アクセンチュアにしかできないこととして、 ERP 導入で蓄積してきた知見をプレイブックとしてナレッジ化し、 AI エージェント（ ※13 ）の判断材料に組み込みました。インターネットの情報や自社の ERP データだけでは判断しきれない部分を、これでカバーできます。 
 構成としては、調達部門や生産部門など部門ごとのエージェントがあり、その結果を人が判断し、再度オーケストレーションしていく形です。外部情報については、ニュースサイトの MCP （ ※14 ）サーバーを使う方法もありましたが、できるだけ SAP 標準を使いたいという思いがあり、たとえば SAP Ariba の API を使って市況情報を取り込むなど、標準を意識して作りました。 

 Q2. 互いの作品に聞いてみたいことはありますか？

 尾濵氏（アクセンチュア） ： 感想になりますが、経営層が抱えるリスクにアプローチし、人の手をできるだけかけずに短時間でソリューションを出す、というベースはアクセンチュアとかなり似ていると感じました。一方で、 3 つのペルソナというアイデアは私たちにはなかったので、面白いなと。

 Q3.AI 時代に求められる人材をどのように育成していくべきだとお考えですか？ 
 森氏（ TISI ） ： ゼロタッチの話が出ましたが、今後は人が判断しなくていい部分はすべてゼロタッチになり、経営者や上位層が判断すべきことにきちんと承認を入れる、という考え方や、そこを設計するコンサルティングが大事になると思っています。 SAP Sapphire などを見て「こういう戦略だから自分たちもこうしないといけない」となったとき、それをリードする人材が必要です。ただ、業務だけをやっていると、そこに踏み込もうと思わない人も多い。そういう人材を戦略的に増やすには、どうチームを組み、新しい領域に取り組めばいいのか。皆さんはどうしていますか。 
 谷村氏（アクセンチュア） ： はっきりした答えではないのですが、今回のハッカソンを通じて、結局はビジネスプロセスが大事だと感じました。 AI に詳しい人を入れるのももちろんひとつですが、 SAP のビジネスプロセスを理解していないと、技術的にゼロタッチができても「それはそこでやっちゃダメなんだよ」ということが絶対にある。従来のビジネスプロセスをきちんと語れる人がいて、テクニカルな人が各プロセスに対して何ができるかを一緒に議論していく。それが大事なのだと思います。 
 SAP ： SAPとしても、パートナーのどんな方に Joule などの AI ツールを触っていただくのがいいかを考えています。プラットフォーム側の開発者はもちろんですが、今おっしゃったように、アプリコンサルのような業務アプリ側を知っている方が、 AI を使って自ら開発領域にも手を伸ばせるようになる。これまでアドオンなどを別チームに任せていた部分を自分で触れるようになることで、生産性が上がり、お客様にとって意味のあるものを作れるようになるのでは、というのが私たちの仮説です。以前、 ABAP のスキルしか持たない方をクラウドの世界でどう育てるか、というテーマがありましたが、それが AI でさらに加速していると感じます。

title: BTPEA正式登陆中国：为SAP BAIP客户带来基于消费的灵活商业模式
author: TiaXu
text:
SAP BTP Enterprise Agreement（BTPEA）于2026年5月21日正式在中国发布（SKU 8016044），为中国市场的SAP BAIP客户带来了按需消费的灵活商业模式。 
 为什么BTPEA登陆中国是重要里程碑？ 
 BTPEA在中国的发布，是拓展SAP BAIP客户商业选择的重要一步——不仅为更多服务进入本地产品目录创造了条件，也让客户在使用SAP BAIP服务时拥有了更多灵活性。 
 1. 为中国引入按量付费的商业模式 
 在BTPEA进入中国之前，订阅制（Subscription）是中国SAP BAIP客户唯一可选的商业模式。BTPEA的引入打破了这一局面，为客户提供了订阅制之外的新选择。 
 订阅制适合业务稳定、服务需求明确的客户；BTPEA则更适合使用量随时间波动的客户。客户可以用预付云积分（Cloud Credit）灵活使用各项符合条件的服务，随业务变化自由切换，只需在合同框架内按实际用量付费。 
 这种灵活性在以下场景中尤为实用：探索新业务场景、应对波动性业务负载、使用难以预估长期用量的服务，或者将稳定业务的订阅承诺与探索性项目的云积分配合使用。 
 2. 丰富中国SAP BAIP服务目录 
 部分SAP BAIP服务仅支持按量消费模式。BTPEA在中国落地后，这些服务也有机会进入中国市场。目前以下纯消费制服务已通过BTPEA在中国上线： Kyma运行时、SAP Build Work Zone高级版、Task Center、SAP Forms Service by Adobe、Object Store、Transport Management、Data Privacy Integration等。 
 这将推动中国市场的SAP BAIP服务目录持续完善，使本地产品供给与全球产品组合更加一致。 
 服务目录越丰富，客户能够选择的SAP BAIP能力就越多，越容易找到真正契合自身业务的服务。 
 什么是SAP BTPEA？ 
 SAP BTPEA是一种按量消费的商业模式，客户以预付云积分的方式使用符合条件的SAP BAIP服务。 
 客户在签订合同时预先购入云积分，约定合同期内每年的最低消费额。实际使用服务产生的费用，将从云积分余额中直接扣除。 
 BTPEA特别适合以下类型的客户：业务方向已明确，但希望保留灵活开通或关停服务的空间；需要在不同服务之间自由切换；以及不希望在整个合同期内锁定在单一服务上。 
 主要优势： 
 灵活性： 可随业务变化在符合条件的SAP BAIP服务之间自由切换。 
 用量透明： 每月收到余额对账单，清晰呈现各服务的使用量及对应费用。 
 简化管理： 用一套预付云积分统一覆盖多项服务，无需为每项服务单独维护订阅合同。 
 用量折扣： 在适用商业条款下，可享受基于用量规模的价格优惠。 
 持续更新的服务目录： 新服务加入消费模式后，客户即可随时开通使用。 
 账单按年预付。若实际用量超出云积分余额，超出部分将按目录价事后结算。客户可随时追加购买云积分，避免超额。 
 BTPEA在中国：可用服务列表 
 可用服务因国家、地区及合同条款而有所不同。客户可通过以下资源查询中国可用的服务及对应定价。 
 1. SAP Discovery Center — 服务可用性与定价参考 
 访问SAP Discovery Center 
 SAP Discovery Center提供服务可用性与定价的参考信息（不具法律约束力）。客户可按 地区 和 商业模式 进行筛选，查看中国市场下BTPEA支持的服务。 
 中国目前开放两个区域： 
 中国（华北3）— cn20 
 中国（上海）— cn40 
 注意：并非所有服务在两个区域均可用。 

 2. SAP BTPEA价格列表 — 合同参考依据 
 访问SAP BTPEA价格列表 
 SAP BTPEA价格列表提供具有法律约束力的合同参考文件。客户可按 国家 和 合同开始日期 筛选，确认适用于自身合同的服务与定价。 
 最终商业条款以实际签署的合同文件为准。 

 混合账户（Hybrid Account）：订阅制与按量消费并用 
 很多客户已有SAP BAIP订阅合同，同时又希望享受消费模式的灵活性。混合账户支持在同一SAP BAIP全局账户（Global Account）下同时运行两种商业模式，让客户在保留订阅承诺的同时，也能使用云积分按需扩展。 
 主要优势： 
 统一管理，降低运营成本： 订阅合同与BTPEA合同共存于同一SAP BAIP全局账户，开发与服务使用均在同一环境中管理，无需维护多套系统。 
 稳定业务锁定折扣，弹性需求按需付费： 对业务量稳定的场景通过订阅承诺享受更优价格，对峰值或探索性项目则用云积分灵活补充，只为实际使用量付费。 
 混合账户如何计费？ 
 计费规则以订阅授权配额为优先，超出部分走消费模式。 
 在订阅配额范围内的使用量，由订阅合同覆盖； 一旦用量超出订阅配额，超出部分将从云积分余额中扣除 ，按消费模式计费。 
 这样，客户既能保留现有的订阅权益，又可借助BTPEA灵活应对额外需求。 

 中国特别说明 
 BTPEA已在中国正式上线，但有几点运营细节需要提前了解。 
 1. Cockpit费用与用量（Cost and Usage）查看 
 SAP BAIP Cockpit中的费用与用量标签页已在中国的消费类产品中上线，客户可直接查看各服务的使用量和对应费用。 
 目前大部分Cockpit功能已可用，但 预算模块（Budget module）在中国尚未完全上线 。 
 客户在规划成本监控流程时需注意这一限制，后续功能上线后将另行通知。 
 2. 余额对账单的发送流程 
 在全球通行流程中，余额对账单（Balance Statement, BS）邮件由SAP直接发送给客户。 中国由于CDC的特殊角色，流程有所不同。 
 在中国，CDC作为SAP的第三方合同代理方，客户与CDC签约而非直接与SAP签约。因此，余额对账单邮件会 先发送至CDC，经CDC翻译后再转发给客户 。 
 相关资源 
 以下资源涵盖消费模式介绍、用量监控和对账单核验，是了解BTPEA的重要参考： 
 SAP帮助门户：什么是基于消费的商业模式？ — 了解消费模式的核心原则与优势。 
 SAP帮助门户：监控全局账户中的用量和费用 — 了解如何查看服务用量和费用明细。 
 SAP Learning：核验余额对账单 — 学习如何核对和确认余额对账单。 
 SAP文档：消费模式CPEA与云积分常见问题 — 消费模式和云积分相关问题的解答汇总。

title: Joule Work Desktop を利用したオンデマンドレポーティング：SAP Integration SuiteによるカスタムMCPサーバーの構築
author: hayato_uemura
text:
近年、生成AIを活用したデータ分析・レポーティングへの関心が急速に高まっています。 
 SAPにおけるAIを使ったデータ分析・レポーティングのアプローチとして、主に2つの方向性が考えられます。 
 SAP Analytics Cloud の Joule Agent によるレポート作成・分析　※2026年末にかけて順次リリース予定 
 Joule Work を利用したオンデマンドレポーティング 
 SAP Analytics Cloud の Joule Agent のリリースを待たずに今すぐAIを活用したデータ分析を試したいお客様は、Joule Work Desktop からSAP Business Data Cloud（BDC）/ SAP Datasphere にアクセスすることで、オンデマンドレポーティングを実現できます。 
 ※Joule から SAP Business Data Cloud のデータプロダクトを直接クエリする機能も今後リリース予定 
 ただし、現時点でJoule Work Desktop からSAP Business Data Cloud のデータにアクセスするには、MCPサーバー（Model Context Protocol Server）を利用し、SAP Datasphereにアクセスする必要があります。SAPでは、エンタープライズグレードのセキュリティ要件・ガバナンス要件を満たした形でMCPサーバーを構築するため、以下の2つの方法を推奨しています。 
 参考： Third Party MCP Server Access to SAP Solutions on BTP 
 Joule Studio によるMCPサーバーの作成　※リリース予定 
 SAP Integration Suite によるMCPサーバーの作成（MCP Gateway機能の活用） 
 本ブログでは、SAP Integration Suite を使ったカスタムMCPサーバーの作成方法を作成し、Joule Work Desktop からSAP Datasphere のデータにアクセスして分析を行う手順を解説します。 
 Joule Work Desktop によるオンデマンドレポーティング全体像 

 Joule Work Desktop によるオンデマンドレポーティング利用イメージ 

 設定手順 
 設定は以下の7ステップで行います。 
 1. SAP Business Accelerator Hub から OpenAPI Specificationのダウンロード 
 2. SAP Datasphere OAuthクライアント作成 
 3. SAP Integration Suite で Security Material を作成 
 4. SAP Integration Suite で MCP サーバーを作成 
 5. SAP Integration Suite で MCP サーバーのバックエンド認証を設定 
 6. Developer Hub で MCP サーバーを公開 
 7. Joule Work Desktop への追加・動作確認 
 【システム要件】 
 本手順を実施するには、以下の環境・権限が必要です。 
 - SAP Integration Suite 
 　- Integration Cell Runtime が「Active」状態であること 
 - SAP Datasphere 
 　- OData API でアクセス可能な分析モデルが存在すること 
 　- 管理者権限（OAuthクライアント作成用） 
 - SAP Joule Work Desktop（アクセス可能なユーザーアカウント） 
 【認証に関する注意事項】 
 本手順では、検証目的で Client Credentials（Technical User） による認証を使用して設定します。本番環境での利用には、API Policyの要件を満たすため SAML Bearer Assertion による認証を推奨します。SAML Bearer Assertionによる認証設定については、SAP Community Blog - Integrating with SAP Datasphere Consumption APIs using SAML Bearer Assertion を参照してください。 
 STEP 1 OpenAPI Specificationのダウンロード 
 SAP Datasphere の OData API（Consumption API）の OpenAPI Specification（JSON形式）をダウンロードします。このファイルは後のStep 4でMCPサーバーを作成する際に使用します。 
 手順： 
 1. SAP Business Accelerator Hub にアクセスします。「SAP Datasphere」を検索し、「Consumption」APIを開きます。 
 2. 「API Resources」セクションの「API Specification」タブから「OpenAPI JSON」のダウンロードアイコンをクリックし、JSONファイルを保存します。 

 STEP 2 SAP Datasphere OAuthクライアント作成 
 Integration SuiteのMCPサーバーがDatasphereにアクセスするための OAuth クライアントを作成します。 
 1. SAP Datasphere の左メニューから「セキュリティ」→「システム」→「管理」→「アプリ統合」タブを選択します。「OAuthクライアント」セクションで、Token URLをメモします。（後のStep 3で使用します） 

 2. 「設定済みクライアント」セクションの「＋」ボタンをクリックし、新規クライアントを作成します。 

 3. 新規OAuthクライアントを作成します。 
 クライアント名を入力します（例：MCP Server ）。「目的」は「技術ユーザー（Technical User）」を選択し、技術ユーザーの名称（例：Technical User for MCP Server ）とMCPサーバーを利用してアクセスするスペースに対応するロールを割り当てます。 

 4. 「追加」ボタンからクライアント作成後、OAuthクライアントIDとシークレットを確認してメモします（Step 3で使用）。 

 STEP 3 SAP Integration Suite で Security Material を作成 
 Integration SuiteからDatasphereにアクセスするための認証情報（Security Material）を登録します。 
 1. Integration Cell Runtimeの確認 
 Security Materialの作成前に、Integration Cell Runtimeが有効化されていることを確認します。 Integration Suite にログインし、左メニューから「Settings」→「Runtimes」を選択します。「Integration Cell」が「Active」状態であることを確認します。 

 2. Security Materialの新規作成 
 左メニューから「Monitor」→「Integrations and APIs」を選択します。「Manage Security」セクションの「Security Material」を開きます。 

 3. 右上の「Create」ボタンをクリックし、タイプとして「OAuth2 Client Credentials」を選択します。 Step 2でメモした情報を入力します。 
 - 名前：任意（例：Datasphere_Technical_User） 
 - Runtime：Cloud Integration and Integration Cell 
 - Token Service URL：DatasphereのToken URL 
 - Client ID：DatasphereのClient ID 
 - Client Secret：DatasphereのClient Secret 

 入力後、「Deploy」をクリックしてデプロイします。 
 STEP 4 SAP Integration Suite で MCP サーバーを作成 
 Step 1でダウンロードしたOpenAPI Specificationを元に、MCP サーバーを作成します。 
 1. 左メニューの「Design」→「Integrations and APIs」を開きます。新規でIntegration Packageを作成、またはMCPサーバーを作成したいIntegration Packageを選択します（今回は新規に作成します）。 

 2. MCPサーバーの新規作成 
 Integration Package内で「Artifacts」タブから「Create」→「MCP Server」を選択します。 

 3. MCPサーバーの作成方法を選択する画面が表示されます。「Import from OpenAPI Specification」を選択します。 
 今回はStep 1でダウンロードしたDatasphereの OData APIのOpenAPI Specificationを使用します。 

 4. OpenAPI SpecificationのアップロードとベースURLの設定を行います。 
 Methodとして「Upload」を選択し、Step 1でダウンロードしたOpenAPI JSONファイルをアップロードします。 
 - Base URL：DatasphereのベースURLを入力します。（例：https://[テナント名].hcs.cloud.sap） 
 - Name：任意（例：SAPDatasphere_MCPServer） 
 - ID：任意（例：sap-datasphere-mcp-server） 
 - Path：任意（例：/mcp-server-datasphere） 

 5. ツール（APIエンドポイント）を選択します。インポートされたAPIのエンドポイント一覧が表示されます。 
 MCPサーバーに含める（JWDから利用可能にする）ツールを選択して追加します。 

 6. 設定を確認し、MCPサーバーを保存・デプロイします。 
 STEP 5 SAP Integration Suite で MCP サーバーのバックエンド認証を設定 
 作成したMCPサーバーがDatasphereにアクセスする際の認証設定を行います。Step 3で作成したSecurity Materialを紐づけます。 
 1. MCPサーバーの「Edit」ボタンから設定画面を開きます。 

 2. 「Policy」タブを選択し、「HTTP」をクリックします。 

 3. 画面下部「Connection」タブで、Authentificationを「OAuth2 Client Credentials」に設定し、Credential NameにStep 3で作成したSecurity Materialを入力します。 

 画面上部の「Save」ボタンで設定を保存し、「Deploy」ボタンでMCPサーバーを再デプロイします。デプロイが完了したことを確認します。 
 STEP 6 Developer Hub で MCP サーバーを公開 
 作成したMCPサーバーをDeveloper Hubに公開し、Joule Work Desktopから接続するための情報（URL・Key・Secret）を取得します。 
 1. Developer Hubにアクセスします。 

 2. 「Admin Center」→「Content」を選択します。 

 3. 「Manage Content」ページでBusiness SystemとしてIntegration Suiteを選択します。 
 STEP 5で作成したMCPサーバーを選択し、「Create Product」をクリックします。 

 4. MCPサーバーのProductを作成し、「Publish」ボタンから公開します。（少し時間がかかります） 
 Name：任意（例、SAP Datasphere Data Access MCP Server） 
 ID：任意（例、sapdatasphere-dataaccess-mcpserver） 

 5. 作成したProductで「Subcscribe」ボタンからAgentのためのSubscriptionを作成します。 

 6. Subscribeが完了すると、以下の接続情報が生成されます。Step 7で使用するためメモします。 
 - Key（Client ID） 
 - Secret（Client Secret） 

 MCPサーバーのURLはProductから確認できます。Step 7で使用するためメモします。 

 STEP7 Joule Work Desktop への追加・動作確認 
 最後に、作成したMCPサーバーをJoule Work Desktopに追加し、実際に動作確認を行います。 
 1. Joule Work Desktopの左メニューの「Extensions」を選択します。「+ New」→「Add Connector」をクリックします。 

 2. Step 6で取得した接続情報を入力します。 
 - URL：MCP Server URL 
 - ID（Key）：Step 6で取得したKey 
 - Secret：Step 6で取得したSecret 

 3. 接続情報を保存すると、Connectorが追加されます。チャット画面でConnectorを有効化するように依頼します。（承認画面がポップアップされるので承認します） 

 4. 動作確認 
 チャット画面でDatasphereに関する質問を入力します。（例、「利用可能なスペースの一覧を取得してください。」）DatasphereのOData APIが呼び出され、アクセス可能なスペースの一覧が返却されれば、設定は成功です。 

 上記の例では、7つのスペースが正常に返却されており、Joule Work DesktopからDatasphereのデータにアクセスできていることが確認できます。 
 データの分析に関する質問をすると、JouleがDatasphereのデータにアクセスし、分析結果を返してくれます。 

 まとめ 
 本ブログでは、SAP Integration Suite の MCP Gateway 機能を使って、SAP Datasphere の OData API をカスタムMCPサーバーとして公開し、Joule Work Desktop から利用する手順を解説しました。 
 Integration SuiteのMCP Gateway 機能を利用することで、エンタープライズグレードのセキュリティやガバナンスを備えたMCPサーバーを作成することができ、安全にAIから利用できます。 
 また、今回はDatasphereの分析モデルにアクセスしデータを取得しましたが、Datasphereの分析モデルでは以下のメリットを享受しながらAIでデータを利用できます。 
 集計済みデータで転送量を削減 ディメンション×メジャーで集計済みのデータが取得できる。AIがそのまま可視化・分析に使えるサイズに整形されている。 
 非累計値（Non-Cumulative）の正確な集計 在庫量・ヘッドカウントのような「単純に足し算できない指標」も、時点ベースで正しく集計できる。生データをAIに渡しても正確に計算できないケースをモデル側で吸収できる。 
 ビジネスロジックが埋め込み済み 制限メジャーや計算メジャーなど、現場のルールをモデルに組み込んであるため、AIへの追加指示なしに正しい定義でデータが渡せる。 
 セマンティック層による文脈理解の向上 フィールド名やラベルがビジネス用語（日本語含む）で定義されているため、AIがデータの意味を正確に把握しやすい。 
 データアクセス制御の一元管理 スペース・ロールに基づいたアクセス制御がモデル側で適用されるため、MCPサーバーが生テーブルを直接公開するより安全 
 ※本手順では検証目的でClient Credentials（Technical User）による認証を使用しましたが、本番環境ではSAML Bearer Assertionによる認証を採用することで、よりセキュアな構成を実現できます。 
 SAP Analytics CloudのJoule Agentや、Joule Studio2.0などが正式リリースされるまでの期間も、本手順を活用することで、今すぐJouleを使ったAIデータ分析を開始できます。ぜひお試しください。

title: SAP Unveils Physical AI and Extends the Autonomous Enterprise into the Real World
author: Lukasz Ostrowski
text:
Most physical AI helps machines act. Physical AI by SAP helps businesses act. By linking robots and physical systems directly to the enterprise processes that run your organization, SAP turns physical execution into a governed, auditable extension of your business, extending the Autonomous Enterprise into the real world. 
 SAP TechEd in 2026: The Autonomous Enterprise Becomes a Reality 

 Read the innovation news guide 

 AI has gone from insight to action and now, with physical AI, it comes into the physical world. 

 Enterprises have made substantial investments in both AI and physical AI. AI helps business systems deliver remarkable insights and recommendations on financials, inventory, and supply chains. Physical AI creates value every day with physical systems—such as industrial robots, humanoids, sensors, or robot dogs—deployed across production lines, warehouses, field service teams, and logistics networks. 

 As automation, robotics, and sensing technologies have matured across industries, the volume and richness of the physical signals coming from physical execution has grown substantially; physical operations today generate continuous intelligence about factors such as asset health, task completion, quality, throughput, and exceptions. 

 Today, however, there is a gap between what the business knows and the intelligence generated by physical operations on the ground. This gap is one of the most common sources of operational friction across industries. It contributes to delayed responses, ill-informed decisions, and physical operations that never enter the business record. As a result, revenue and margins decrease while risk exposure increases. 

 From enterprise intelligence to physical action 

 This year at SAP TechEd , SAP revealed how our physical AI removes this operational friction: the system that runs your business is the same system that controls your physical operations. 

 The enterprise knowledge in your business system triggers the physical actions; physical signals arrive with the business context already attached; physical operations in the field flow back into SAP as structured data intelligence. Every physical action leaves a traceable, auditable record tied to the relevant business process. 

 The full context of your business is behind every physical action; verified outcomes are brought back into SAP in a secure and governed way for follow-up actions. 

 When the system that runs your business is also the system that governs how, when, and why physical tasks are executed, the result is a fundamentally different kind of operational capability. For enterprises already running SAP, this means physical execution inherits the intelligence, context, and governance already in place. 

 This is how physical AI by SAP transcends automation and extends the Autonomous Enterprise into the real world. 

 “Foxconn’s vision for intelligent manufacturing requires physical systems that understand business context, not just motion commands,” said Dr. Wang, head of Physical AI at Foxconn. “With physical AI by SAP, warehouse tasks from SAP Extended Warehouse Management directly orchestrate our humanoid robots and autonomous transport systems. Asset inspections triggered by maintenance plans flow to our robotic platforms and return verified outcomes back to SAP. This closed loop between enterprise systems and physical execution is what sets this collaboration apart: the robot knows why it acts, and the business system knows what happened.” 

 How physical AI by SAP capabilities are designed to transcend automation 

 1. Business-driven physical action 

 Physical AI is built to ground every physical execution in the business context: order priorities, safety rules, inventory status, and compliance constraints. Every action has a clear reason tied to business outcomes, and the business system remains in control of what gets executed, when, and why. The result is physical execution that is intelligent from the start, not just automated. 

 2. Physical evidence into digital workflows 

 Every physical task creates a complete audit trail and physical observations flow back into SAP automatically, transforming field outcomes into business insights rather than isolated records in a separate system. Physical world events become inputs to the decisions and processes that follow. 

 3. Enterprise-governed execution 

 Built on the SAP Business AI Platform, physical AI capabilities are designed to provide traceability, auditability, and human-in-the-loop control as first principles. Physical world data flows into SAP Business Data Cloud as new structured data products, enriching planning, predictions, and operational strategy over time. 

 4. Vendor and hardware agnostic 

 Working across device platforms, physical systems, and AI models of the customer’s choosing, customers retain freedom over their physical layer. SAP provides the business context, orchestration, and governance. Partners provide the physical execution. 

 Physical AI at work with customers and partners 

 Arçelik-LG: physical AI executes and records inbound storage tasks 

 Arçelik-LG is a joint venture between Turkish durable consumer, Arçelik and South Korea’s LG Electronics, manufacturing air conditioners. Physical AI by SAP enables a humanoid robot to execute and record inbound storage tasks. This has addressed the costly and persistent issue of incorrect storage placements in inbound logistics with potential savings of millions of euros. 

 Associated SAP solutions: SAP Extended Warehouse Management 

 Physical AI ecosystem partners: FairConsult 24|7 

 Video: Arçelik-LG 

 Intel: physical AI in autonomous warehouse operations 

 Intel is one of the world’s largest semiconductor manufacturers, operating a vast global warehousing and logistics network and serves as both a proof-of-concept environment and a technology collaborator. By integrating SAP’s enterprise workflows and warehouse processes with Intel-powered edge AI and robotics technologies, warehouse transport tasks generated in SAP are automatically translated into robot missions and executed autonomously in the warehouse. 

 SAP provides the business context, workflow governance, and process orchestration, ensuring that every physical action aligns enterprise priorities and operational goals. Intel provides the physical AI hardware and software foundation at the edge, delivering the compute AI and real-time robotics capabilities that enable autonomous systems to perceive, decide, and act in dynamic environments. The combined capabilities of SAP and Intel create a closed-loop system; business decisions become physical actions and operational outcomes are continuously fed back into business systems. 

 In a proof of concept demonstrated at Intel’s Chengdu site in China, material movement is automated end-to-end, reducing both transport distances and repetitive manual handling. Physical AI capabilities from SAP and Intel demonstrate how enterprise decisions can directly drive physical execution in logistics workflows. 

 Associated SAP systems: SAP Extended Warehouse Management 

 Physical AI ecosystem partners: Anu Intelligence 

 Holcim: industrial asset inspections 

 Holcim is a Swiss multinational building materials and sustainable construction company, operating in heavy industry. The company has significant infrastructure assets with inspection, maintenance, and safety use cases. Since attending the Embodied AI Jam held in August 2026 , Holcim has implemented physical AI capabilities for asset inspections with industrial drones and quadruped dogs. 

 On-site quadruped dogs inspect conveyor belts in dark, dusty areas and the status of kilns in extreme temperatures. Drones inspect assets in heights difficult for humans to reach. And end-to-end automation starts and finishes in a SAP system. In SAP’s asset management solution, the maintenance plan triggers an action for the industrial drone/quadruped dog; once the action is executed, a maintenance notification is created back into SAP. 

 Associated SAP systems: SAP Plant Maintenance 

 Physical AI ecosystem partners: Cyberwave , Field AI , Hybird 

 Video: Holcim 

 Start your physical AI journey today 

 From warehouse operations to asset maintenance, from safety inspections to keeping your operations compliant, physical AI capabilities from SAP have the potential to transform your business. It connects the intelligence of your enterprise with real-world execution; the SAP system that you trust to run your business is the same system that informs the actions of your physical systems, be it a robot, an industrial drone, or a robodog. 

 As a part of Industry AI, you can begin your physical AI journey today with warehouse operations and asset inspection use cases or a physical AI use case, tailor-made to your requirements. Contact SAP via email for more information .

title: From Orbit to Enterprise: The Next Tabular AI Frontier for SAP and HPE
author: Brenda Bown
text:
Today, SAP announced the planned deployment of SAP-RPT, our tabular AI foundation model, on HPE Spaceborne Computer-2 aboard the International Space Station (ISS), one of the most significant edge-compute validations of an enterprise AI model to date. 
 SAP TechEd in 2026: The Autonomous Enterprise Becomes a Reality 

 Read the innovation news guide 

 Space is unforgiving. Vacuum, radiation, orbital debris, and solar storms can produce mission-critical crises at any moment. Adding to the complexity, onboard sensors and mission system telemetry produce too much time-sensitive data to be routed back to Earth for analysis. Latency has to be reduced to ensure the safety of the spacecraft. 

 Enter SAP’s tabular AI foundation model, SAP-RPT , which makes predictions directly from structured data—even with some data missing—and without requiring the usual model training or fine-tuning. Running directly onboard the ISS on HPE Spaceborne Computer-2, it supports anomaly triage in real-time telemetry data, predicts issues before failures escalate, reconstructs missing sensor values based on historical data, and generates explainable mission-health reports for astronauts and ground teams. 

 “This is proof that tabular AI on SAP works at the edge of possibility,” said Mayank Shrivastava, vice president of Generative AI and Foundation Models at SAP SE. “Space is the ultimate stress test for AI. If a foundation model can predict mission-critical failures in orbit, under radiation, energy, and connectivity constraints, imagine what it can do for a global enterprise. This is the same model that will predict supplier risk, cash flow anomalies, and equipment failures across your enterprise. What works in orbit works in your supply chain.” 

 Imagine this: in orbit, data arrives in fragments, connectivity comes and goes, and you cannot send a technician when something starts to fail. You have to anticipate problems with a variety of signals. Enterprises face the same challenge on the ground: a supplier whose deliveries are quietly slipping, a payment pattern that’s drifting, a compressor that’s running hot. Predictive models that are able to spot early warning signs in a satellite are also built to find those same signals in your business data, so you can act before small problems become critical ones. 

 How SAP strengthens business functions with models for structured data 

 SAP-RPT is part of SAP’s portfolio of tabular foundation models, or TFMs, that includes the TabPFN model by Prior Labs, and SAP AI Core , which orchestrates, manages, and governs TFMs, predictions, and workflows. Large language models (LLMs) excel at language and reasoning, but TFMs are built for the structured tabular data that underpin real-world operations, such as the sensor-driven data used in this project. 

 SAP-RPT is about 50,000 times more energy-efficient than state-of-the-art LLMs. This is especially important in space, where every watt is constrained. SAP-RPT is also highly adaptable. It requires no pre-training as conditions evolve. 

 Outcomes that will be delivered onboard include real-time predictions for computer and mission health status, an overall mission risk score, an assessment of whether manual intervention is needed, human-readable explanations of AI-driven findings, and ad hoc reports for crew and ground teams. 

 “HPE Spaceborne Computer-2 continually demonstrates the advantages of having a high-performance compute solution aboard the ISS, supporting advanced technologies and on-going research in space” said Scott Wiest, Vice President and Global Sales Chief Technologist, HPE Fellow. “Deploying SAP’s tabular AI on HPE Spaceborne Computer-2 shows what’s possible with real-time detection and prediction using AI in the ultimate edge environment.” 

 From orbit to enterprise 

 The deployment of SAP-RPT on HPE’s Spaceborne Computer-2 on the ISS, by early 2027, will show how it strengthens business functions on earth. The constraints of space, including extreme energy limits, intermittent connectivity, radiation interference, and zero tolerance for failure are relevant to challenging use cases on earth. These include disaster relief operations, agriculture in remote areas, distributed manufacturing, and spread-out supply chains. 

 Every insight aboard the ISS accelerates SAP’s road map for enterprise edge AI and key use cases that leverage structured data for the most important analytical and operational processes, even in the most challenging settings. 

 Looking ahead, the mission lays the groundwork to support space-based data centers, deep space exploration, and other collaborations on space missions. Our long-term vision for space-based compute infrastructure is anchored in proven, efficient, and accurate AI. 

 Explore how to deliver tabular AI on SAP, learn more about the specialized capabilities behind it, and try the SAP-RPT AI model with your own data on the Tabular AI area of sap.com . 

 Brenda Bown is chief marketing officer for SAP Business AI Platform and Joule at SAP.

title: SAP Empowers AI Developers to Build What Matters and Turn Intent into Autonomous Execution

text:
International Space Station’s use of tabular AI and expanded partnerships demonstrate the art of the possible with SAP AI 

 BERLIN — SAP SE (NYSE: SAP) today announced a series of AI innovations at its annual SAP TechEd conference that expands its portfolio for developers. 
 SAP TechEd in 2026: The Autonomous Enterprise Becomes a Reality 

 Read the innovation news guide 

 The enhancements to the Joule Studio and Joule Work solutions and SAP Business AI Platform, including the latest tabular foundation model from SAP, offer new tools to build and extend AI agents, a richer data and business context for those agents to reason with, and strengthened governance controls to run them responsibly across the enterprise. 

 SAP Business AI Platform gives organizations one place to build, contextualize and govern AI across SAP and third-party environments. With Joule Studio, business users and developers can use no-code and pro-code tools to build and extend agents, choosing from more than 70 AI models. Customers in the Joule Studio early adopter program also can design and run n8n workflows in Joule Studio, with broader availability to follow. The SAP Business Data Cloud and SAP Knowledge Graph solutions ground those agents in trusted business data and context, helping organizations select the right model for each use case and better manage AI value and consumption. Importantly, SAP customers’ data remains their data. SAP does not share customer data with anyone to train or improve large language models. 

 “SAP TechEd has always been where builders shape what comes next,” said Philipp Herzig, CTO of SAP SE. “This year, we are showing how we are moving from AI learning your business to running it. Joule Work is where you put your intent and get work done, in one experience across the entire SAP landscape and beyond. That is the shift we are delivering at scale. Everything underneath runs on SAP Business AI Platform, delivering faster time to value through out-of-the-box business understanding, higher accuracy, enterprise-readiness that is secure, governed and compliant from the first deployment, and a unique context layer built on over 50 years of process and industry expertise, encoded into every agent action. This is AI built where real work happens.” 

 Joule Work and Joule Studio Make the Autonomous Enterprise Real 

 New capabilities for Joule Work will help make AI agents more effective at handling complex business processes via open protocols including Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP). These innovations advance Joule Work to better understand context, make decisions and execute multistep business workflows across enterprise systems and business domains: 

 New agentic thinking capabilities that plan and orchestrate the steps assistants and agents need to reliably complete complex, multistep business workflows across SAP landscapes. 

 New capabilities in SAP Knowledge Graph will incorporate data from additional SAP and non-SAP sources that are unique to each customer. Users can query and explore their customized data in natural language and get accurate answers grounded in their own information. 

 Advancements in interoperability allow third-party agents to securely invoke Joule Agents through a governed agent gateway. This enforced access control enables agents from different providers to collaborate across business workflows without sacrificing governance or control. 

 New SAP Enterprise AI Gateway solution will extend governance to AI interactions, offering a centralized way to manage AI traffic across the enterprise that will consolidate authentication, policy enforcement, routing, monitoring, usage tracking and auditing. 

 New Joule Assistant and SAP AI Agent Hub expand governance capabilities, and a new AI Governance Assistant helps customers meet compliance requirements for the EU AI Act. These are designed to address critical barriers to scaling enterprise AI: keeping AI systems classified, compliant and operating within defined organizational guardrails and context. 

 SAP also announced that Joule Studio has new observability and administrative controls to give developers and administrators visibility into agent behavior, model usage and spend. Joule Studio is SAP’s AI-first development environment that is accessible through Joule Work for building and extending enterprise agents. Joule Studio will run a time-bound promotion for select customers, where deploying and running custom agents on the SAP-managed Joule Studio runtime will remain free through December 2026. The design-time tooling for building and testing agents and n8n workflows with AI-assisted development will remain free under fair-use limits. 

 SAP Business Data Cloud as the Grounding Engine of the Autonomous Enterprise 

 SAP Business Data Cloud Ontology Manager in SAP Business Data Cloud (SAP BDC) will provide an AI-native authoring experience for building ontologies across SAP and third-party data. By helping AI understand how data from different teams, systems and applications relate to one another, AI agents can more accurately reason and make decisions across the enterprise. The solutions complement SAP Knowledge Graph, which provides rich business context for SAP data. 

 Additionally, SAP is expanding its lakehouse capabilities with Dremio, adding native support for Apache Iceberg and Apache Polaris plus a high-performance, federated query engine that will enable unified data access without moving or copying the data. SAP expands its partnership with Databricks, bringing the full scope and latest innovations of data engineering and enterprise AI capabilities into SAP Business Data Cloud as SAP Databricks. Core innovations such as Lakeflow, Agent Bricks, Unity Gateway, and Lakebase will help customers to simplify data management and provide a strong data foundation for their AI journey. With a deeper integration to SAP Business Data Cloud, a new SAP Application Data Foundation, as well as an integration between Joule and Genie, SAP and Databricks are helping customers establish an enterprise-wide lakehouse as the foundation for the Autonomous Enterprise and Joule Work. 

 The SAP Reltio solution, recently announced at SAP Connect, will bring multidomain master data management to SAP BDC. It unifies and enriches customer, supplier and product records across SAP and non-SAP systems into trusted, reusable data products that can power applications and AI agents. 

 Tabular Foundation Model Trusted for Business, Validated in Space 

 SAP announced its latest tabular AI model, SAP-RPT-2.0, which will expand beyond classification and regression to support anomaly and outlier detection, and richer AI-powered analysis through embeddings. These native, multi-table capabilities will further reduce manual engineering while delivering faster, deeper insights from structured data. In addition, a new SAP-RPT-TS model will help customers predict values across time-indexed business metrics for key forecasting use cases using the SAP Integrated Business Planning solution without requiring custom machine learning. 

 In partnership with HPE , SAP also announced the deployment of SAP-RPT on the HPE Spaceborne Computer-2 aboard the International Space Station (ISS), one of the most significant edge-compute validations of any enterprise AI model to date. SAP-RPT is planned to run directly onboard the ISS to support anomaly triage, predict issues before failures escalate, reconstruct missing sensor values from historical data, and generate explainable mission-health reports for astronauts and ground teams — all without requiring data to be sent back to Earth for analysis. 

 “The same trusted SAP-RPT model that powers global supply chains also can work in space,” said Herzig. “SAP’s deep-rooted, proven expertise has led to the International Space Station’s use of our tabular foundation model to predict potential mission-critical failures in orbit. With SAP-RPT and TabPFN from Prior Labs, we bring the unique capabilities of tabular AI into the enterprise and across every frontier.” 

 Out-of-the-Box Assistants and Agents Define Our Advantage 

 For five decades, SAP has built the systems of record that run your business. We will deliver, out of the box, a suite of assistants and agents across five horizontal domains all running on SAP Business AI Platform — with industry specialization — that provides a baseline for systems of intelligence and systems of action. 

 Ecosystem Partners Help Expand Platform Capabilities 

 The global SAP partner ecosystem brings new capabilities to the ongoing operation and extension of solutions on SAP Business AI Platform, helping customers advance toward the Autonomous Enterprise. At SAP TechEd, the following partner announcements were highlighted: 

 A collaboration with Intel closes the loop between enterprise workflows and autonomous robots, bridging informational technology and operational technology through physical AI. 

 In addition, new SAP solution extensions with Docusign , Parloa and Redwood extend autonomous capabilities for customers, helping them run their core processes end to end, without handoffs between systems. 

 Beyond technology, SAP is empowering its strong developer community with new enablement and engagement with tens of thousands joining for Devtoberfest leading up to SAP TechEd, new reference architectures, tutorials and hands-on opportunities attendees can try onsite at the event and at home.

title: What's New in SAP Automation Pilot – Q3 2026
author: dona_pavlova
text:
SAP Automation Pilot ships 15 new features in Q3 2026 – including native AI-agent authentication, a persistent key-value storage shared across executions, and over 60 new provided commands. 
 If you're running automations on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), your toolkit just got a serious upgrade. This quarter touches everything from how you connect to external systems, to how automations persist data between runs, to how you track what's actually happening across your landscape. Here's the full picture. 

 New to the product? ​ 
 It's a low-code/no-code automation service on SAP BTP that helps DevOps and Operations teams automate cloud operations – with over 300 built-in commands and a serverless script execution environment. More details about the product can be found at: 

 SAP Automation Pilot Documentation 

 Usage Statistics Dashboard 
 SAP Automation Pilot now has a built-in dashboard that shows you how your automations are actually being used. You can see the number of executions by day and hour, which commands get triggered most, success rates, and how much of your quota you've consumed – all with time-range filtering. If you've been piecing this picture together manually or through external tools, it's now right inside the service. For more information, see Working with Executions . 

 Subexecutions Panel in Execution Details 
 When you open an execution's details page, there's now a dedicated Subexecutions section that lists everything the parent execution triggered. Subexecutions also get tagged automatically – autopi:parentExecutorPath tells you which executor started them, and for ParallelForEach, autopi:parentBatchIndex tells you which batch they belonged to. No more jumping back and forth to understand what a complex command actually did. For more information, see Monitoring Executions. 

 Capture HTTP User-Agent as a Service Tag 
 When an external system triggers an execution via the API, SAP Automation Pilot now reads the User-Agent header from the HTTP request and stores it as a read-only autopi:userAgent service tag. This means that even when multiple systems share the same service account, you can tell which one triggered which execution – directly from the details page or by filtering via the API. It takes zero configuration on the SAP Automation Pilot side – the caller just needs to set a meaningful User-Agent header, which is a one-line change in any HTTP request. For more information, see Tags . 
 Configurable Table Columns with Custom Tag-Based Columns 
 The entity tables in SAP Automation Pilot – Commands, Inputs, Executions, Scheduled Executions – can now be personalized. You can show or hide predefined columns, reorder them, and add custom columns based on your tag keys. So if your team tags executions by environment, region, or ticket number, those values can now show up as their own columns instead of being buried inside each execution's detail view. For more information, see Configuring Table Columns. 

 Command Clone with Multiple Cloning Modes 
 Cloning commands now gives you three distinct modes. Clone Full Command copies the entire configuration into a new command, so you can adapt and extend it without touching the source – this one is available for custom commands. Clone Contract Only keeps the same input and output keys but gives you an empty implementation to build from scratch. Clone as Wrapper creates a new command with a single executor that calls the source command, with all parameters automatically mapped – so you can add logic around it without reconfiguring anything manually. Both Clone Contract Only and Clone as Wrapper are available for provided commands as well, giving you a proper starting point when building on top of SAP-provided content. For more information, see Cloning Commands . 

 Secure Service Account Integration for AI Agents 
 Service accounts in SAP Automation Pilot now support token-based authentication – meaning the credentials can be used as a Bearer token or an API key, on top of the existing Basic authentication. The service account type has been renamed to API Token / Basic and the password field is now called token to reflect this. 

 Why does this matter? Because MCP clients, Joule, and most third-party agent frameworks expect token-based auth. Until now, wiring them into SAP Automation Pilot required workarounds. Now it's a native, one-step setup. Alongside this, a new MCP permission lets you scope exactly which MCP server endpoints a service account can access – so you can give an AI agent the ability to trigger automations without granting access to anything beyond what the agent needs. 
 If you're building agent-driven Ops workflows, this is the feature that makes it practical. For more information, see Managing Service Account Permissions. 
 Native Destination Service Integration & HTTP Request Enhancements 
 The new HttpRequestViaDestination command lets you execute HTTP requests by referencing a destination from the SAP Destination Service directly. URL resolution, authentication, proxy settings, certificates – all of it is pulled from the destination configuration automatically. No more duplicating credentials and connection details inside SAP Automation Pilot. If you're already managing your connectivity through the SAP Destination Service, your automations can now plug straight into that setup. For more information see HTTP Operations (http-sapcp) Catalog. 
 SendEmail STARTTLS Support 
 The SendEmail command now supports STARTTLS encryption through a new encryptionMode input key. Previously, sending emails through public SMTP servers that require STARTTLS meant routing traffic through SAP Cloud Connector. Now you can connect directly – one less hop, one less thing to configure. For more information, see Email Operations (email-sapcp) Catalog . 

 Cross-Execution Runtime Storage 
 Until now, each execution in SAP Automation Pilot lived in isolation – once it finished, its data went with it. That changes with the new Cross-Execution Runtime Storage: a tenant-scoped, encrypted key/value storage that any execution can read from and write to. Three commands handle everything – PutValue , GetValue , and DeleteValue . 
 This unlocks automation scenarios that simply weren't practical before. Executions can now pass state to each other, track progress across multi-step workflows, cache shared configuration, or coordinate processes – all without relying on external storage. If you've ever built a workaround to share data between executions, this is the clean, built-in replacement. For more information, see Execution Runtime Storage. 

 SAP Integration Suite Provided Catalog 
 SAP Automation Pilot now ships a dedicated catalog for SAP Integration Suite – 21 ready-to-use commands covering integration flow lifecycle management, configuration updates, monitoring of deployed integration flows, and directory management. All accessible directly from the provided catalogs, no custom command building required. 

 This is a significant expansion. SAP Integration Suite is one of the most widely used services on SAP BTP, and until now, automating operations around it meant building everything from scratch using HTTP requests. With a provided catalog in place, teams can automate routine integration operations – deploying flows, checking statuses, updating configurations. 
 If you're managing integration landscapes at scale, this catalog saves a lot of custom work. For more information, see SAP Integration Suite (is-sapcp) Catalog. 
 SAP HANA Cloud Lifecycle Management Commands 
 A new SAP HANA Cloud Administration catalog brings 40 commands for managing SAP HANA Cloud instances – covering provisioning, lifecycle management, configuration, and observability across both Cloud Foundry and Other Environment deployment types. 
 We covered this catalog in depth in a dedicated blog post – you can find it here: Meet the SAP HANA Cloud Administration Catalog for SAP Automation Pilot 

 Granular Skip Options for ParallelForEach Failures 
 When a ParallelForEach step fails, the Skip dialog now offers two distinct options – skip only the current failed batch and continue processing the remaining ones, or skip all remaining batches and move on to the next executor in the parent command. Previously, skipping meant stopping everything. Now you can isolate a failure without halting the entire parallel run. For more information, see Controlling Executions with Actions. 

 Custom Tags for ParallelForEach Subexecutions 
 You can now assign tags to ParallelForEach subexecutions dynamically using expressions. Instead of entering tags manually for each subexecution, you reference a complete tag set from an input and it gets applied automatically, making it easier to organize, filter, and trace parallel workloads at scale. For more information, see ParallelForEach. 
 Auto-Abort Stale Failed Executions 
 A new Auto-Abort Failed Executions feature automatically aborts executions that remain in a Failed state without updates for a configurable duration (1–168 hours). Your execution list stays clean without manual intervention. For more information, see Additional Features. 
 Immediate Deletion of Completed Executions 
 You can now delete completed executions on the spot instead of waiting for the retention cleanup cycle. Setting the retention value to 0 causes immediate deletion as soon as an execution reaches a completed status. When an execution is done and you no longer need it, it's gone, keeping your execution list manageable without relying on automated retention policies. For more information, see Additional Features. 
 Learn More & Stay Connected

 Release Navigator for SAP Automation Pilot - find release notes, blog posts, and related resources in one place

title: Give Your AI Agents Long-Term Memory: SAP Agent Memory Service Is Now Generally Available
author: shabana
text:
Every agent session starts from scratch. That has been the reality for most AI agents today. Ask an agent to help you resolve a billing dispute, and it might ask you the same clarifying questions it asked last week, with no recollection of your preferences, your previous decisions, or the work you've already done together. This is not a limitation of the LLM, it is a fundamental gap in how agents are built. Without persistent memory, every interaction starts at zero. 
 With the General Availability of SAP Agent Memory Service in Q3 2026, that changes. 
 The Problem: AI Agents That Forget Everything 
 Enterprises deploying AI agents face a challenge that is easy to overlook but costly in practice: agents are stateless by default. When a session ends, the context ends with it. Preferences, past decisions, in-progress workflows, and the outcomes of previous conversations all disappear. 
 This creates friction in exactly the scenarios where agents are supposed to save time, for example: 
 A collection agent asks a customer to re-confirm payment preferences it has already captured. 
 An HR assistant forgets that a user prefers documents in German and generates English responses each time. 
 A configuration transport agent has no memory of approvals completed in a previous session, restarting an hours-long workflow from the beginning after a timeout. 
 Stuffing chat history into the prompt as a workaround is expensive, fragile, and hits context window limits fast. What agents need is not a bigger prompt, they need real, durable memory. 
 Introducing SAP Agent Memory Service Powered by SAP HANA Cloud 
 SAP Agent Memory Service is a fully managed, persistent memory layer for AI agents on SAP BTP. It gives agents the ability to store knowledge across sessions, retrieve it semantically when it is needed, and maintain an auditable log of their interactions, all backed by SAP HANA Cloud's vector engine and governed with enterprise-grade retention controls. 
 Powered by SAP HANA Cloud's built-in NLP capabilities, Agent Memory Service is not just a key-value cache. It is an evolving memory store that allows agents to write what they learn, recall what matters by meaning rather than keyword, and improve over time as memories accumulate. All agent memories and messages are stored directly in your SAP HANA Cloud instance, the same trusted, enterprise-grade database that already powers your business data. so, your agent context lives where your data lives, governed by the same security and compliance controls you already rely on. 
 SAP Agent memory Service Powered by SAP HANA Cloud (Note - *Planned items 2027) 
 How It Works 
 Agent Memory Service stores two types of records: 
 Memories are durable, semantically searchable knowledge entries - facts, decisions, summaries, and preferences that an agent should recall across future sessions. When an agent writes a memory, the service automatically generates a vector embedding using SAP HANA Cloud's NLP engine. At retrieval time, a vector similarity search surfaces the most relevant memories for the current context, even when the query shares no keywords with the stored content. 
 Messages are raw, chronological conversation logs grouped by session. They give agents an auditable, replayable record of every interaction - essential for compliance, handovers, and multi-turn context within an active session. 
 All data is scoped to an (agentID, invokerID) pair, ensuring that memories and messages are isolated per agent and per user, with no cross-contamination between tenants, agents, or users. 
 The service exposes a standard OData REST API with four key endpoints: 

 No proprietary SDK is required. An optional Python client is available via the SAP Cloud SDK for Python for those who prefer it. 
 What Becomes Possible 
 Agent Memory Service transforms what an agent can do across three dimensions: 
 Continuity across sessions - A user's preferences, in-progress tasks, and past decisions survive session boundaries. When a user returns, whether hours or weeks later, the agent picks up where they left off. For example - "Customer prefers consolidated invoices" is automatically recalled in every billing cycle, without the user needing to say it again. 
 Leaner, more precise prompts - Rather than appending entire conversation histories to every prompt, agents retrieve only the top-K semantically relevant memories per turn. This keeps prompts lean, reduces LLM costs, and improves response quality. 
 Improvement over time - As memories accumulate and access timestamps update, agents get sharper without retraining. Frequent dispute patterns are recognized and resolved faster. Recurring questions are anticipated and addressed proactively. 
 Human oversight and control - Users can inspect, edit, or delete their memories directly, providing full transparency. Audit teams can trace how a billing decision or dispute was handled, turn by turn, using the message log. 
 Getting Started 
 Agent Memory Service is available as a standalone SAP BTP service subscription tied to your SAP HANA Cloud instance (Bring Your Own HANA plan). 
 Provision via SAP BTP Service Marketplace - In your SAP BTP subaccount, add the hana plan for SAP HANA Cloud and the hana-agent-memory plan as entitlements. Provision an SAP HANA Cloud instance or use your already existing one (make sure to enable "nlp": true in the ‘Advanced Setting’ configuration - this is required for semantic search). Then create an Agent Memory Service instance using the ‘hana-agent-memory’ plan, link it to your HANA Cloud instance, and create a service key. The key gives you the clientid, clientsecret, url, and application_url fields needed to authenticate via OAuth 2.0 client credentials. 
 Subscribe to 'hana-agent-memory' service plan on SAP BTP Cockpit 

 Call the API directly or use the SAP Cloud SDK for Python - Once provisioned, you can call the OData REST API from any HTTP client. For Python-based agent development, the SAP Cloud SDK for Python provides an optional client that handles authentication and request handling, with ready-to-use patterns for storing memories, running semantic search, logging conversation turns, and managing retention. 
 For the full step-by-step setup guide, API samples, and best practices, see the SAP Help Portal: Agent Memory Service Guide . The complete API reference and interactive sandbox are available on SAP Business Accelerator Hub . 
 Conclusion 
 The journey toward agentic SAP HANA Cloud has been about making agents smarter at every layer, from the data they discover and query, to the context they carry with them over time. 
 Agent Memory Service addresses the most fundamental limitation in today's agent architectures: the absence of persistent, governed, enterprise-grade memory. With it, agents stop being one-shot tools and become evolving partners. 
 For developers, this means: 
 A managed, persistent memory layer that works across SAP and non-SAP agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, SAP BAIP, and custom agents) 
 Semantic retrieval powered by SAP HANA Cloud's vector engine, no external embedding service required 
 Native integration in Joule Studio (planned towards 2027) and the SAP Cloud SDK for Python 
 Built-in governance: configurable retention, data isolation, OAuth 2.0 security, and audit logging 
 With Agent Memory Service now generally available, SAP HANA Cloud continues to establish itself as the database for SAP's AI-native software architecture, not just storing data, but helping agents remember, learn, and improve across every interaction. 
 Note on availability: The service is currently available on a bring-your-own SAP HANA Cloud model, where you provision and manage your own HANA Cloud instance. A fully managed offering, where SAP handles the underlying infrastructure entirely, with no HANA Cloud instance required on your end, is planned towards the end of 2026. Stay tuned for updates.

title: Updating SmartRecruiters Job Fields via API When Position Mapping Is Not Available
author: khasija
text:
Overview 
 SmartRecruiters is SAP's next-generation recruiting platform, integrated within the SAP SuccessFactors HCM suite. When creating job postings, recruiters work with a set of standard job fields that directly influence the candidate experience on the career site — how jobs are categorised, filtered, and discovered. 
 Five fields are especially important: Location, Function, Industry, Experience Level, and Type of Employment. These are structural picklist fields that drive job-board categorisation, candidate search filters, and downstream application workflow logic. 
 As documented in KBA 3746432, there is currently a product gap: these fields cannot be automatically populated from a Position object in SAP SuccessFactors. This means every job created via Position must have these fields manually updated by a recruiting stakeholder — an inefficient and error-prone process at scale. 
 This blog presents a supported workaround using the SmartRecruiters REST API combined with a job.created webhook to automate the update as soon as a job is created. 
 Understanding the Product Gap 
 The five affected fields and their impact on the recruiting process are summarised below:
